Figure 8: Forces on a model rocket in flight. Thrust, drag, weight, and side force, as well as the velocity vector, have been shown for a rocket in general flight attitude (that is, the rocket is neither flying vertically nor at zero angle of attack). Wind-free conditions have been assumed.
